description: Comparative gnomAD constraint across the four enzymes of histidine degradation
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={"Content-Type":"application/json","User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}
GENES={"HAL":"histidine ammonia-lyase (step 1)","UROC1":"urocanate hydratase (step 2)",
       "AMDHD1":"imidazolonepropionase (step 3)","FTCD":"formimidoyltransferase-cyclodeaminase (step 4)"}
LOF={"frameshift_variant","stop_gained","splice_acceptor_variant","splice_donor_variant","start_lost","stop_lost"}
Q="""query V($g:String!){ gene(gene_symbol:$g, reference_genome:GRCh38){
 gnomad_constraint{ exp_lof obs_lof oe_lof oe_lof_upper pLI }
 variants(dataset: gnomad_r4){ consequence lof exome{ac an homozygote_count} genome{ac an homozygote_count} } } }"""
res=[]
for g,desc in GENES.items():
    d=requests.post("https://gnomad.broadinstitute.org/api",json={"query":Q,"variables":{"g":g}},timeout=180,headers=H).json()
    gd=d["data"]["gene"]; c=gd["gnomad_constraint"] or {}
    rows=[]
    for v in gd["variants"]:
        ac=an=hom=0
        for s in (v.get("exome"),v.get("genome")):
            if s: ac+=s.get("ac") or 0; an=max(an,s.get("an") or 0); hom+=s.get("homozygote_count") or 0
        rows.append((v["consequence"],v.get("lof"),ac,an,hom))
    df=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["csq","lof","ac","an","hom"]); df["af"]=df.ac/df.an.replace(0,np.nan)
    pl=df[df.csq.isin(LOF)]
    res.append(dict(gene=g, step=desc, oe_lof=c.get("oe_lof"), oe_up=c.get("oe_lof_upper"), pLI=c.get("pLI"),
                    obs_lof=c.get("obs_lof"), exp_lof=round(c.get("exp_lof") or 0,1),
                    n_plof=len(pl), q_plof=float(np.nansum(pl.af)), plof_hom=int(pl.hom.sum()),
                    max_plof_af=float(np.nanmax(pl.af)) if len(pl) else np.nan))
t=pd.DataFrame(res)
t["carrier_1_in"]=(1/(2*t.q_plof)).round(0)
t["biallelic_1_in"]=(1/t.q_plof**2).round(0)
pd.set_option("display.width",220)
print(t[["gene","step","obs_lof","exp_lof","oe_lof","oe_up","pLI","n_plof","q_plof","plof_hom","carrier_1_in","biallelic_1_in"]].to_string(index=False))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
ax.bar(t.gene, t.oe_lof, yerr=[np.zeros(len(t)), t.oe_up-t.oe_lof], color="#5b6b7c", capsize=4, width=0.55)
ax.axhline(1.0, color="#b4553a", ls="--", lw=1.4); ax.text(3.35,1.02,"no constraint",color="#b4553a",fontsize=8,ha="right")
ax.set_ylabel("observed / expected pLoF"); ax.set_title("None of the four histidine-degradation\ngenes is LoF constrained")
ax=axes[1]
ax.bar(t.gene, t.plof_hom, color="#b4553a", width=0.55)
for i,v in enumerate(t.plof_hom): ax.text(i,v+0.4,str(v),ha="center")
ax.set_ylabel("pLoF homozygotes in gnomAD v4"); ax.set_title("Biallelic loss-of-function individuals\nare present for every step")
ax=axes[2]
ax.bar(t.gene, 2*t.q_plof*100, color="#5b6b7c", width=0.55)
for i,v in enumerate(2*t.q_plof*100): ax.text(i,v*1.02,f"{v:.2f}%",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("predicted pLoF carrier frequency (%)"); ax.set_title("Carrier frequencies, gnomAD v4")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
